title: engagement_state item (EngagementState)
description: Per-engagement projection: real base version, single offer, decline history (annotation only, DEC-21), sequence guards. No workpaper content (RF-010). Source: DISENO S3 (b)(c), PRD RF-010, §2.4.
$comment: Table engagement_state (per cell). PK = ENG#<engagementId>, SK = STATE. GSI1 (inverted index, RF-017): GSI1PK = TV#<templateId>#<currentVersion>#S<shard>, GSI1SK = <engagementId>, projection INCLUDE firmId, branch, offerTarget, version. GSI2 (firm listing, RF-033): GSI2PK = FIRM#<firmId>#S<shard>, GSI2SK = <offerStatus>#<offerSince>#<engagementId> or NONE#<engagementId> without offer (DEC-29); projection INCLUDE engagementId, templateId, branch, currentVersion, state, offerTarget, offerSince, offerStatus, previouslyDeclined, flags, updatedAt. shard = hash(engagementId) mod N_shards (DEC-10). TTL attribute: ttl, set only on ARCHIVED tombstones (TTL_tomb, DISENO 4.6). Access patterns: AP-I1 GetItem PK; AP-I2 Query GSI1 x N_shards; AP-I3 conditional UpdateItem (version, lastSeq); AP-I4 Query GSI2 x N_shards; AP-I9 Query GSI2 begins_with APPLIED_WITHDRAWN#; AP-I10 Query GSI2 begins_with NONE#. Streams NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES feed the CDC-outbox relay (ADR-019, DEC-06). 'state' carries DISENO 'classification'. GSI1 keys only while state = CLASSIFIED. Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).

GSI1PK.description: GSI1 partition key (inverted index). GSI1PK = "TV#<templateId>#<currentVersion>#S<shard>". Present only once the base version is known (CLASSIFIED).

GSI2PK.description: GSI2 partition key (listing by firm). GSI2PK = "FIRM#<firmId>#S<shard>".

GSI2SK.description: GSI2 sort key. GSI2SK = "<offerStatus>#<offerSince>#<engagementId>"; with no offer (offerStatus NONE) GSI2SK = "NONE#<engagementId>" (DEC-29).

region.description: Residency region / cell of the firm (e.g. EU, CA).

branch.description: Market branch of the engagement lineage (A.2-e).

offerTarget.description: Offer target version label (PRD RF-010 offerTarget).

offerSince.description: Instant the offer was materialised (PRD pendingSince).

offerStatus.description: Offer status (DISENO 3.8.2): NONE = no offer yet; SUPERSEDED/WITHDRAWN stay only when there is no new target; APPLIED_WITHDRAWN stays until a new offer appears.

previouslyDeclined.description: Version labels previously declined and contained in the target (annotation, A.2-c; EV-17).

declineHistory.description: DeclineRecord list: audit/annotation only, never filters eligibility (DEC-21). Fields from EV-10.

lastSeq.description: Last applied engagementSeq (RF-081). Condition: attribute_not_exists(lastSeq) OR lastSeq < :seq.

lastHookAt.description: Instant of the last hook; inspections with observedAt <= lastHookAt are discarded (RF-014).

ttl.description: DynamoDB TTL attribute, epoch seconds. Duration = named parameter TTL_tomb (no value fixed in the docs). Only set when state = ARCHIVED (tombstone, DISENO 4.6).

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency attribute (CLAUDE.md DynamoDB rules; RF-067): every write is conditional on the previous value and increments it.

createdBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id that created the item; system writers use the service-principal uuid configured per service.

updatedBy.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): principal id of the last write; changes on every write.

updatedAt.description: Audit (technical, mandatory): instant of the last write; changes on every write.

state.description: Classification (DISENO 'classification'): UNCLASSIFIED -> CLASSIFIED -> ARCHIVED (tombstone). Lifecycle and who sets it: DISENO 3.8.2 (DEC-27).
